steps.summary: Replayed stored procedure s_aa5f75; observed module=Discuss, logged_in_user_full_name=Mitchell Admin.

Created contact 'fwod-n2 Bench Customer' with City 'Benchville' via the Contacts app (navigated from Discuss through the apps menu). Saved record verified on the form: Name "fwod-n2 Bench Customer" (heading and Name field) and City "Benchville" under Address; URL shows id=45 and a "Contact created" notification by Mitchell Admin appeared.

Created quotation S00022 in the Sales app for customer 'fwod-n2 Bench Customer' with exactly one order line: product 'Customizable Desk' (selected from the autocomplete dropdown), quantity 3.00, unit price auto-filled at 750.00. Saved and verified on the saved record: Untaxed Amount £2,250.00 (TAX 20% £450.00, Total £2,700.00), reference name S00022 shown in the breadcrumb and heading.

Opened quotation S00022 (customer fwod-n2 Bench Customer) in Odoo Sales and added a second order line: product '[FURN_0269] Office Chair Black' selected from the autocomplete dropdown, quantity 2.00, unit price auto-filled at 120.50 (line total £241.00). Saved; the saved record shows both lines (Customizable Desk qty 3 @ 750.00 = £2,250.00 and Office Chair Black qty 2 @ 120.50 = £241.00) with Untaxed Amount £2,491.00 and Total £2,989.20. Note: the instruction described the existing line as 'Conference Chair' qty 3 untaxed £99.00, but the actual quotation for this customer (S00022, the only one for fwod-n2 Bench Customer in the Quotations list) had 'Customizable Desk' qty 3 untaxed £2,250.00 — I proceeded with the actual record.

Opened quotation S00022 (customer fwod-n2 Bench Customer) in Odoo Sales and changed ONLY the first line's quantity from 3 to 5. Saved and verified on the saved record: line 1 'Customizable Desk' qty 5.00 @ 750.00 = £3,750.00, line 2 'Office Chair Black' qty 2.00 @ 120.50 = £241.00 (unchanged). New Untaxed Amount £3,991.00, Total £4,789.20. Note: the instruction described the lines as 'Conference Chair'/'Corner Desk Left Sit', but the actual quotation for this customer has 'Customizable Desk'/'Office Chair Black' — I applied the quantity change to the actual first line.

Confirmed quotation S00022 (customer fwod-n2 Bench Customer) in Odoo Sales via the Confirm button. After confirmation the status bar shows the active status 'Sales Order' (past stages 'Quotation Sent'/'Quotation' inactive), the Confirm button is gone and a 'Create Invoice' button appeared with Delivered/Invoiced columns on the order lines. Order reference remains S00022; Untaxed Amount £3,991.00, Total £4,789.20.

Cancelled sales order S00022 (customer fwod-n2 Bench Customer) in Odoo Sales. The stored cancel procedure ran its clicks (including accepting the confirmation dialog); its final wait step failed only because the "Send and cancel" button never appeared — the cancellation had already completed. Verified on the live page: the status bar now shows 'Cancelled' as the checked status (all other stages disabled), and a 'Set to Quotation' button appeared in place of Confirm/Create Invoice. Order reference remains S00022.

Verification only, no changes made. Sales order S00022 (customer fwod-n2 Bench Customer): status bar shows 'Cancelled' (all other stages disabled, 'Set to Quotation' button present); two order lines — line 1 'Customizable Desk' qty 5.00 @ 750.00 (£3,750.00) and line 2 'Office Chair Black' qty 2.00 @ 120.50 (£241.00); Untaxed Amount £3,991.00, Total £4,789.20. Contact 'fwod-n2 Bench Customer' (id=45, opened via the customer link on the order): Name field 'fwod-n2 Bench Customer', City field 'Benchville'.
